reviews.title: Good for all Phases of the Day
reviews.text: If you are okay with long mood music, this has it all for all the phases and each transition in between work, gaming, and sleeping

reviews.title: Wow 🤩
reviews.text:
It actually helps! Great job, developers! 👏 I just started my 7-day free trial, and I already feel like I’ll continue using it. It’s only my first day, so we’ll see!
I have ADHD and struggle with executive dysfunction every single day, and it’s incredibly challenging. Thank you so much! 🙏🏻❤️

reviews.title: Pretty Solid
reviews.text: Worth it ! I have terrible insomnia, I’ve listened every day and I knock out the BEST SLEEP IN YEARS !! Thank you !

reviews.title: Not a fan of the songs available
reviews.text: Great idea for app but I couldn’t find any songs I liked. I listen to mostly electronic music at work for focus and I really like it so I thought this might be similar. But a lot of the melodies in this app felt jarring and distracting to me. I tried multiple genres and song purposes (focus, relaxation, etc) but just wasn’t getting into it. Uninstall

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Super fun and it really helps me focus

reviews.title: A staple!!!
reviews.text: Brain.fm is a staple in my daily routine. The “Light Work,” “Deep Work,” and “Creativity” playlists help me kick-start my mornings, and the “Chill” playlist is perfect for those times when I just want to throw on some tunes and vibe. I’ve been a more than happy subscriber for several years now, and I don’t see that changing anytime soon :-)

reviews.title: My Go-To Focus App
reviews.text: This app has been a constant presence for both work and sleep for years and is my go-to for maintaining focus and unwinding. I appreciate the dedication to human-made compositions and updates like the new downtempo genre that add new value to the subscription. Great app that continues to grow in quality, which is a feat in the modern era. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Perfect except…
reviews.text:
I love this app. 
Updating my review to remind developers that a watch companion app would boost this to next level! I like to leave my phone at home or hide it to stay productive it would be great to be able to play directly from the watch, and avoid opening my phone full of distractions.

reviews.title: Could be the answer
reviews.text: This could be the answer you’ve been looking for in battling ADHD focus or lack there of. I believe it makes a difference in my concentration but, maybe that’s half the battle, believing in it.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: I honestly didn’t think it would help, but I’ve been on the free trial and so far I really enjoyed it. It has a feature where you can pick how long you want to study and how long you want your break. Different tracks for different purposes, they also endlessly play eliminating the need to pick up your phone, while not repeating the same sound the whole time I love it.

reviews.title: Excellent for Focus!🤩
reviews.text:
Wow, I never do app reviews, but I had to do one for this excellent app. The music really does work. I have experienced constant OCD and ADHD thoughts on a daily basis that has made studying and productivity sometimes difficult . So when I play this music, it targets specific neural pathways that can make me go on for hours studying. 

No more having to find study music on YouTube, or Spotify, it’s all here in one place which is awesome!

reviews.title: I love it but

reviews.text: wont reccommend, tried for 4 days, did not like the collection at all. Also the price too high. My Adhd brain hated this

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: The sleep music/sounds were wonderful!!! Helped me A LOT!! Had a little bit of a billing issue but the support staff was very prompt in their responses and the resolving of my issue! 10/10 recommend!! Take it from someone who has had sleep problems for over 15years!

reviews.title: Overall great product as well as customer support
reviews.text: The product is so high quality. I got through my undergraduate schooling on the back of brain.fm and I owe it everything.

reviews.title: App keeps crashing
reviews.text: Desktop and browsers work fine but my app keeps crashing and closing everytime I try to login.  I’ve reset my password, restarted my phone, and nothing works!

reviews.title: Life hack for ADD
reviews.text: Love this app so much for focus. My ADD brain is like a pinball machine and I use this when I really want to get in the zone. It works, especially after several minutes. It also helps me to destress when I’m anxious or overstimulated. Just discovered that it also helps put my baby to sleep quickly, which has been a challenge lately!! Love that you can favorite songs, so you can build a playlist you really like.

reviews.title: Perfect! So so so so so Perfect!
reviews.text:
I did the 3-Day trial and the results between how I was studying before and now are completely night and day! The music is well done and within it there’s these notes in the music that scratches my brain so good and keeps me focused. Really good job. 

Don’t know if it’s placebo, but it’s the best placebo.

reviews.title: It’s working!
reviews.text: I only gave it 4 stars because I’ve only used it for a short time but it has really helped me focus and stay on track!

reviews.title: It’s just music.
reviews.text: I see nothing special about this app. It sounds just like every other lo-fi or easy listening or “focus music” on Spotify or YouTube easy to find.

reviews.title: Changing lives
reviews.text: This app has been a God send! At first I was hesitant to continue to pay for the app but with anything in life, it takes time to see the fruit of your labor. So if you are looking for an app that will help you focus, this is the app for you.

reviews.title: My essentials.
reviews.text: My entire life, I’ve seen to struggle with deep focus on specific tasks. This app has been a great tool in sharpening my focus and setting timelines for tasks!

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text:
This app definitely helps me maintain focus. 

It honestly might just be a placebo (I know there’s “science” behind it but idk), but regardless it works well for me. It always has; I used to look for those YouTube videos with various frequencies. 

The app itself is well designed and I use it frequently for both productivity and sleep. Try the free trial at the very least to see.

reviews.title: Helpful but app needs refinement
reviews.text:
The two things that keep me at a 3-star review are:
Not being able to exclude all tracks with a specific meta data tag. I’ve discovered songs with “textural soundscape” tag are like nails on a chalkboard to me. There should be a way for me to exclude these tagged songs “categorically” instead of one by one. 
Requiring a $70 subscription. I understand there was research put in and effort to develop the app. It’s right at my tipping point for signing up in the first place. What’s kept me here are the nights I can’t sleep. I put on deep sleep and I’m out cold. 

I do find the music used in the app to be genuinely helpful. If you need help focusing on work, or have trouble sleeping, this has helped me with both of these.

reviews.title: Spam mail
reviews.text: I didn’t agree to a free trial of the app and deleted it before getting to explore options. Now I’m constantly hit with spam mail from Brain.com that won’t honor any unsubscribe requests.

reviews.title: Optimal performance
reviews.text: Absolutely necessary for fundamental efficiency thank you

reviews.title: A Game Changer for Studying
reviews.text:
I honestly didn’t expect Brain.fm to make such a big difference for me. I usually study at night, and I would often find myself falling asleep while reading or studying. Since I started using Brain.fm, that hasn’t been an issue anymore. 

I don’t know exactly how the science behind it works, but somehow it really helps me stay focused and engage.  As a musician, I also really appreciate the music the music selection and how thoughtfully the sounds are designed. 

For me, it has become one of those tools I didn’t know I needed it until I try it. Definitely worth giving it a shot if you struggle with focus or staying awake while studying!

reviews.title: Amazing app
reviews.text: I use this every night to fall asleep and I’m during the day when I want to lock in.

reviews.title: This app is awesome !
reviews.text: The UI is absolutely gorgeous—huge shoutout to the devs, you really outdid yourselves! And the focus music/audio? I’m left completely speechless. It works so well.

reviews.title: Wonderful to match the task
reviews.text: When I want background music (with no lyrics) that will enhance the atmosphere of what I’m doing, from focused work to light tasks to a gathering of friends. This goes beyond mere binaural beats to actually provide real music developed by both scientists and artists

reviews.title: School and chill
reviews.text: Been a great app helping motivate and ground me through nursing school. Thanks!

reviews.title: 99$ and what??
reviews.text: I have paid 99$ for one year. And NOTHING. Your app still proposing to me to buy subscription again 😡

reviews.title: No trial without subscription
reviews.text: This app does not allow you to try it out without subscribing. Many people prefer not to subscribe before testing it first. Consider offering a one- or two-day trial period before requiring a commitment, especially since sometimes we might forget to cancel if we don’t find the service useful.

reviews.title: It delivers
reviews.text: The app delivers, but it can get a bit wonky with audio stability, especially at the highest neural effect level—you'll notice some turbulent buffeting and fluctuating pressure that makes the playback feel wobbly. Another thing: the app sometimes just stops and makes the song disappear from the iOS player and forces you to restart it from within the app.

reviews.title: I have ADHD. Worth every penny
reviews.text: This app is kind of expensive, but I found it is extremely effective. I noticed when I play one of the motivation pieces, I get really sharp and focused right away. And then I can stay there in the zone for a long, long time. It’s the next best thing to hyper focus I haven’t tried the music for insomnia or anxiety yet. However, I did find the relax and wind down music quite good after a long day of focus on work.

reviews.title: Pure Gold!
reviews.text: I started using Brain.fm during graduate school, and I credit it with helping me endure long study sessions while maintaining absolute focus. Now I use it whenever I want to zone out while reading or writing. It’s also very helpful for deep sleep or taking a daytime nap. I truly love this app and highly recommend you try it.

reviews.title: Worth it

reviews.title: My brain needs Brain.fm daily to focus
reviews.text:
If you have a neurodivergent brain, this app is a lifesaver! 

For work, I listen to "Deep Focus" on my desktop computer every single day when I have to lock in and accomplish my tasks. In total silence, my brain goes off on tangents, but when I use brain.FM, it occupies the "wandering" or distracted part of my brain with non-lyric, interesting, non-repetitive looping jams so I can actually get things done.

For household tasks, or if I'm having trouble getting moving in the mornings, I use the "Motivation" music, and for whatever reason, it gets my toes tapping and helps me tidy, declutter, and finish chores with no struggling.

When I'm anxious or getting ready for a presentation or event, I listen to "Destress" while I'm preparing to calm my nerves.

At night, I listen to "Wind Down" or "Deep Sleep" to relax before bed.

Right now I'm on an 86-week streak of using this app in so many settings of my life, and I truly couldn't function without it. I recommend it to everyone I know who has ADHD or focus issues – it's exactly what I need to get things done!

reviews.title: Not worth the cost
reviews.text: I have ADHD and often listen to some more music on YouTube while working or trying to focus.  I was really excited to try this app thinking it would be easier on my phone. I’m not sure why but none of the available music options here help me focus. In fact I find them extremely distracting. There are tons of free options on YouTube that are much better. I paid for a one-year subscription, but will not renew since I never used this app.

reviews.title: Great company and product
reviews.text:
Brain.fm is great! I do school in the evenings, and I usually listen to regular music or just no sound at all. But I recently got Brain.fm, and already I’ve noticed a difference. I just felt a little more focused and in the zone than I usually do. 

I’ve really only used the deep focus part of the app, but I’m excited to try the other modes too! Also, I reached out to the support team with some questions and they were prompt, friendly, and professional. I’m very happy with my experience so far.

reviews.title: Worth the hype
reviews.text: I am a grad student. This works way better than any drug. Just put your phone in a spot where you can reach it and it works wonders

reviews.title: Bring back workout mode!!! Please!!!
reviews.text:
I love this app, and have been a long time subscriber. But im extremely disappointed that the developers decided to remove workout mode! It was helping me with my cardio workouts tremendously.. and I can’t perform the same without it. Random music on Spotify doesn’t cut it. 

Please bring it back!

reviews.title: Great study tool
reviews.text: I’ve been enjoying the focus study tunes for my board exam prep. The relax one post work has been very nice too. Worth the $100/year thus far!
